title: NIST says water freezes at 0 °C and boils at about 100 °C
summary: On the Celsius scale as NIST's temperature page states it, water freezes at 0 °C and boils at about 100 °C. The word about is on the page.
body: NIST's temperature page says that on the Celsius scale, water freezes at 0 °C and boils at about 100 °C, that one Celsius degree is an interval of 1 K, and that zero degrees Celsius is 273.15 K. The boiling point is written as about 100 °C on that page, not as an exact integer. The Celsius offset itself is the separate definition t/°C = T/K − 273.15.

sources.title: SI Units – Temperature
